message.content: During LLM decoding, each generated token requires reading model weights and the KV cache from VRAM, so the process is often memory-bandwidth-bound rather than compute-bound. Higher VRAM bandwidth lets the GPU move this data faster, increasing tokens per second and reducing latency.
